meta.name: Control Room
meta.description: Control Roompresents a rare window into the US invasion of Iraq from the perspective of Al Jazeera, the Arab world’s most popular news outlet. Widely criticized and condemned by military figureheads, government officials and the mainstream media in the west for reporting with a “pro-Iraqi bias”, airing civilian causalities, as well as showing footage of American POWs,Control Roomreveals the situation in Iraq that the US government does not want you to see…
